summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its previously authorized common stock repurchase and finalizing cancellation of the repurchased shares. Under board resolutions dated May 15 and July 30, 2026, Mizuho repurchased 24,352,700 shares for ¥199,999,944,900 (versus a ¥200bn cap; up to 35,000,000 shares) via trust-method market purchases between May 18 and September 18, 2026, with 6,126,300 shares (¥52,934,875,300) bought September 1-18. All 24,352,700 shares (1.0% of pre-cancellation shares outstanding) cancel October 23, 2026. Watch remaining authorization vs. buyback pace and any EPS accretion signal.
